title: EEG-HealthLLM: Hierarchical Adaptation of Large Language Models for Unified Heterogeneous EEG Health Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.01652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive means for neurological and mental health assessment, yet existing EEG models are typically developed for individual tasks and are difficult to unify across heterogeneous signal configurations and assessment objectives. Large language models (LLMs) offer a common interface for multiple tasks, but adapting heterogeneous EEG signals to a shared LLM raises a key challenge: how to preserve task-specific signal characteristics while enabling effective language-side parameter sharing. To address this problem, we propose EEG-HealthLLM, a unified and parameter-efficient framework for heterogeneous EEG health assessment. We introduce an Asymmetric Hierarchical Adaptation Strategy: task-specific EEG adapters preserve heterogeneous spatio-temporal dynamics, while a unified shared LoRA is injected into the LLM backbone (e.g., Phi-3) to capture shared high-level assessment semantics across tasks. translated_title: EEG-HealthLLM：面向统一异构脑电健康评估的大语言模型分层自适应方法
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）为神经与心理健康评估提供了一种无创手段，然而现有的EEG模型通常针对单个任务开发，难以在异构的信号配置与评估目标之间实现统一。大语言模型（LLMs）为多任务提供了通用接口，但将异构的EEG信号适配到共享的LLM上存在一个关键挑战：如何在实现语言侧参数有效共享的同时保留任务特定的信号特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EEG-HealthLLM，一个面向异构EEG健康评估的统一且参数高效的框架。我们引入了一种非对称分层自适应策略：任务特定的EEG适配器保留异构的时空动态特征，同时在LLM骨干网络（如Phi-3）中注入统一的共享LoRA，以捕获跨任务的共享高层评估语义。我们……
tldr: 提出EEG-HealthLLM框架，通过非对称分层自适应策略——任务特定EEG适配器保留异构时空动态、共享LoRA注入LLM骨干网络——实现统一且参数高效的异构脑电健康评估。
en_tdlr: EEG-HealthLLM unifies heterogeneous EEG health assessment via an asymmetric hierarchical adaptation strategy, where task-specific EEG adapters preserve heterogeneous spatio-temporal dynamics while a shared LoRA injected into the LLM backbone (e.g., Phi-3) enables parameter-efficient cross-task semantic sharing.
